description: Poland UOKiK Decisions - competition and consumer protection. Search decisions of UOKiK, Poland's competition and consumer protection authority (about 22,000 decisions): merger clearances, abuse of dominant position, collective consumer interests, prohibited clauses, product safety and fuel quality, with decision number, date, named parties and practice type; includeDetails adds case signature, whether a fine was imposed, appeal status, industry (PKD) and region. Filter by party name (literal - Polish diacritics matter), practice type, decision number, case signature, industry, region, fine/appeal flags, date range or full text. The register records THAT a fine was imposed, never the amount - do not report one. Use for counterparty due diligence and regulatory-history checks on Polish companies. No API key. Advanced fields beyond this schema are also accepted (regdata_describe lists them).

caseSignature.description: The case file signature, e.g. "DKK-2.430". Matches a prefix as well as a whole signature.
caseSignature.title: Case signature

dateFrom.description: ISO date, YYYY-MM-DD. Note that six records in the register carry no decision date at all and are excluded by any date filter.
dateFrom.title: Decided on or after

fineImposed.description: Whether the decision imposed a fine. The register records only THAT a fine was imposed - it never publishes the amount.
fineImposed.title: Fine imposed

fullText.description: Free text searched across the whole document index. Broader than it looks - it matches text the decision page does not display, so use the specific fields above when you can.
fullText.title: Full-text term

includeDetails.description: Open each decision to read its case signature, fine flag, appeal status, industry and region. Off returns only what the result list shows: number, date, party and practice type.
includeDetails.title: Fetch full decision details

includeIncompleteRecords.description: The register holds six documents with no number, date or party. They are skipped by default and always counted in the run summary.
includeIncompleteRecords.title: Include records that identify nothing

industry.description: Matches the whole PKD path, so "SEKCJA K" selects the entire financial sector while "TELEKOMUNIKACJA" selects one class. Because the register stores the path but each decision page shows only the leaf class, a match can look unrelated and still be correct - "BUDOWNICTWO" returns electrical-installation firms, which sit under Section F.
industry.title: Industry (PKD)

maxItems.description: Optional cap on billed dataset items returned.

participant.description: Name of a party to the proceedings, e.g. "Orange". Matches whole words in the party field, case-insensitive. Polish diacritics matter - the register's search is literal.
participant.title: Company or person

practiceType.description: The category of proceedings. Roughly: merger control 5,800 decisions, product-safety conformity 4,000, collective consumer interests 4,000, dominant position 1,900.
practiceType.title: Type of practice

region.description: Region the decision applies to. A decision can list several.
region.title: Voivodeship

name: regdata_uokik_decisions
